# access.Invitation

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

An invitation to join an organization at a node with roles (SP1 spec §6.2).

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `access.Invitation` |
| Kind | `entity` |
| PII | `personal` |
| Tenancy scope | `organization` |
| Permission | `core.member.read` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `acceptedByUid` | yes | `personal` | User who accepted it; null until then. |  |
| `createdAt` | yes | `none` | When the invitation was created (UTC). |  |
| `email` | yes | `personal` | Invited email; accepting requires the same verified email. |  |
| `expiresAt` | yes | `none` | When the invitation stops working (UTC), 7 days after creation. |  |
| `id` | yes | `none` | Automatic id of the invitation. |  |
| `invitedBy` | yes | `personal` | User who sent the invitation. |  |
| `node` | yes | `none` | Node the invitee will be granted at. |  |
| `roles` | yes | `none` | Roles the invitee will get (no escalation). |  |
| `status` | yes | `none` | pending, accepted, revoked or expired. |  |
| `tenantId` | yes | `none` | Organization the invitation is for. |  |
| `updatedAt` | yes | `none` | When the invitation last changed (UTC). |  |

## Relations

- `belongs-to` `tenancy.Organization` via `tenantId`
